---
title: "React, live queries, and files"
description: "Use the generated browser client without shipping SQL."
---

The generated React app uses Better Auth as its session and organization store. Chardb asks that client for JWTs when a query, mutation, or file request runs.

```tsx
import { createAuthClient } from "better-auth/react";
import { anonymousClient, jwtClient, organizationClient } from "better-auth/client/plugins";
import { ChardbProvider } from "@chardb/core/react";

const authClient = createAuthClient({
  baseURL: window.location.origin,
  plugins: [anonymousClient(), organizationClient(), jwtClient()],
});

function endpoint(): string {
  const protocol = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws";
  return protocol + "://" + window.location.host + "/ws";
}

<ChardbProvider endpoint={endpoint()} auth={authClient}>
  <Workspace />
</ChardbProvider>
```

The component imports the registered handles directly:

```tsx
const { data = [], state } = useQuery(listMessages, {
  organizationId,
  limit: 50,
});
const post = useMutation(postMessage);

await post({
  id: uuidv7(),
  organizationId,
  body: "hello from the browser",
  attachment: null,
  clientCreatedAt: Date.now(),
});
```

`useQuery` receives complete replacement snapshots. The browser does not merge row patches or treat cached rows as current authorization.

Files use the same organization authority and row policy:

```tsx
const messageAttachment = fileRef("messages", "attachment");
const attachment = useFile(messageAttachment);

const uploaded = await attachment.upload({
  organizationId,
  file,
  idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID(),
});
```

Store `uploaded.fileId` through a registered mutation. Download URLs still check the active organization and row policy.

The generated Vite plugin removes server implementations from the browser build:

{/* contract: ../docs-examples/generated-app/vite.config.ts */}
```ts vite.config.ts
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { chardb } from "@chardb/core/vite";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";

const workerOrigin = process.env.CHARDB_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8787";
const workerSocket = workerOrigin.replace(/^http/, "ws");

export default defineConfig({
  publicDir: false,
  plugins: [
    react(),
    chardb(),
  ],
  build: {
    outDir: "public",
    emptyOutDir: true,
  },
  server: {
    host: "127.0.0.1",
    port: 5173,
    strictPort: true,
    proxy: {
      "/ws": { target: workerSocket, ws: true, changeOrigin: true },
      "/_chardb": {
        target: workerOrigin,
        changeOrigin: true,
        configure(proxy) {
          proxy.on("proxyReq", request => request.setHeader("origin", workerOrigin));
        },
      },
      "/api": workerOrigin,
      "/health": workerOrigin,
    },
  },
});
```
